 History

 v0.7.0 hotfix-1 

 Jul 1, 2022 

 - Fixed a bug, which did not saved user points for driver or team. 
- Fixed wrong statistics for full qualification format. 
- Fixed minor renderer bugs.

 v0.7.0 

 Jun 29, 2022 

 - Big new feature: renderer 2.0 (flex renderer) 
- New default theme (for the new renderer) 
- New render type images (layouts) - calendar, season progress by positions and by points. 
- Added F1 2022 season. 
- Removed feature: migration from the old database (0.5.x and earlier) function. Please, use 0.6.x version for this. 
- Improved error handling 
- Minor app loading optimizations 
- Added handling of database inconsistency where multiple rows for the same session contained the same position or driver. 
- Added new cars from ACC Challenger Pack DLC 
- Fixed an issue where uploading a database to the cloud for the current user was performed when changes were received from another user. 
- Fixed an issue when podiums statistics include also minor races when the related option is enabled 
- Fixed the minimum value for "Ignore the worst events" for season settings. 
- Limit drivers (in rendering options) max value was increased to 60. 

Details in our discord server: https://discord.gg/faE4bmnJmz 

 v0.6.3 

 May 10, 2022 

 What's changed? 

- Added "Users Database" page including info about all users of same cloud storage. 
- Added leagues promotion section on "Welcome" page. 
- Added new option "Dnf drivers can be classified" for a season. 
- Added new circuits for ACC championship. 
- Minor improvements for displaying combined qualification results. 
- Added information about the sequence number of the race in the rendering of the race results. 
- Fixed bug with missing cloud synch after app updating. 
- Fixed "replacement current database file" error when trying to load a database from the cloud with the same name as the current database. 
- Fixed bug when trying to delete windows scheduler task. 
- Fixed bug where the category list in the UI was not updated for a new driver. 
- When calculating the average grid to finish changing position season statistics, not only live sessions are now taken into account. 
- Auto checking for app updates not processing when live session is active. 
- Libraries updated up to date.

 v0.6.2 hotfix-1 

 Apr 28, 2022 

 What's changed? 

- Fixed bug with disappearance of Fastest Lap points and appearance of P31 on Point System page. 
- Fixed an issue with live timing freezing after qualifying.

 v0.6.2 

 Apr 26, 2022 

 What's changed: 

- Added line-ups text generation for Discord with formatting (race numbers and skip events in row) 
- Changed the calculation of points for the Half Points option - now the points for the fastest lap and DotD will also be halved. 
- Increased the range of positions for points management to 60 (need to create a new championship before with the desired grid size). 
- Improved seasons menu visibility. 
- Fixed some bugs when creating a new season. 
- Fixed bug when deleting a team. 
- Fixed a bug in which point system settings were not saved. 
- Fixed bug of displaying gaps as plus laps when applying a time penalty. 
- Fixed an error when calculating qualification statistics for combined qual. 
- Fixes for car-based line-ups. 
- Small fixes for combined qual. 
- Added new country (Guyana).

 v0.6.1 

 Apr 11, 2022 

 What's changed: 

- Fixed 2 critical bugs related to creation of live session, causing to bugs while loading database. 
- Minor UI improvements.

 v0.6.0 

 Apr 9, 2022 

 A very BIG update compared to the previous versions. The list of changes is so huge that it's easier to describe what has NOT changed.

 v0.5.0 

 Oct 19, 2021 

 What's new? 

- Added option "Save extended info (lap data and more)" in "Live timing options" window (enabled by default). 
This option allows app to save session's extended info (lap/sector times for all drivers and more info) recieved from the session results when using live timing feature into the database. 

- Added new render types (only for race results): 

"Pure race pace analysis" * 
Shows "pure laptime" and performance rating for S1, S2, S3 sectors (for each driver). 

"Consistency rating" * 
Shows overall consistency rating, "avg diff" and consistency rating for S1, S2, S3 sectors (for each driver). 

"Top fastest laps" 
Shows lap time, lap number, S1, S2, S3 times. 

"Longest stints" 
Shows number of laps on stint, type of tyres and avg lap time. 

* - this features available only for users who supported this project. 

- Added export lap data (for race and qualification results, for all drivers) to csv file. 
- Improved qualification results render. Now it shows sector times (S1, S2, S3) and number of laps for each driver (if data is available). 
- Added option "Use top-10 rule for driver who set fastest lap in race" 
- Some bugs fixed.

 Reactions: 
 A Kadir , ERZ_Deki and cfjv1982 

 v 0.4.1 

 Sep 8, 2021 

 What's new? 

- Added a tyres icon next to the fastest lap for each driver in the race result 
- Added a tyres icon next to the fastest lap of session badge 
- Added a column with information about the number of races in a season next to each driver in the line-ups picture 
- Rebalanced driver's matching 
- Added option to switch off auto fixing results from live timings 
- Added option to save udp dump to file 
- Added feature to replay session from udp dump file and autofixing results after 
- Fixed a bug when upload to the cloud was not performed after database changes - Fix issue when driver's info not updates after driver was chosen in race result 
- Base nationality now has the highest priority on render images

 Reactions: 
 cfjv1982 and ERZ_Deki
